release_notes: HikMicro HM-TD8168-190ZE4FL is an anti-corrosion thermal & optical bi-spectrum stable positioning (PTZ) camera pairing a 640x512 uncooled VOx thermal channel (NETD < 25 mK, 19-190 mm) with a 4 MP optical channel (4 mm panoramic + PTZ zoom 10-900 mm) and a laser illuminator up to 3000 m, adding 360 continuous pan, perimeter-protection VCA, dynamic fire/smoke detection and -20 to 150 C temperature measurement for port, dock and island perimeters.
